title: EXT_materials_bump glTF Material Extension
description: glTF extension that defines a bump which perturbs the surface normal.

bumpFactor.description: The strength of the bump displacement.
bumpFactor.gltf_detailedDescription: When `heightSpace` is absent, a unitless strength whose scale is implementation-defined. When `heightSpace` is present, the height in metres per unit of the sampled red channel, measured in that space.

bumpTexture.description: A texture that defines the displacement in the red channel.
bumpTexture.gltf_detailedDescription: A texture that defines the displacement in the red channel. This will be multiplied by bumpFactor.

heightSpace.description: The space in which the bump height is measured.
heightSpace.gltf_detailedDescription: When present, `bumpFactor` is a length in metres. `world` measures it in world space. `object` measures it in the node's local space, so it scales with the node transform. When absent, the scale of `bumpFactor` is implementation-defined.
